worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.summar: Breathes fire in a forward fan. Stat boosts and potion/beacon buffs increase the hit and cause a burn.
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.use.0: Punish an opponent that just powered up
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.use.1: Sweep a line of enemies standing in front of the user
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.use.2: Suppress a set-up sweeper with burn
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.descri: The fire fan has a %2$s-block radius and %3$s-degree spread, hitting up to %4$s enemies once each for about %1$s special damage.
Each empowerment level adds %1$s times the base power, capped at an extra %2$s. Positive stages in the five combat stats and potion/beacon buffs count; level I counts once.
An empowered target is burned for %1$s plus %2$s per level. Burn weakens physical attacks and removes about 1/16 of maximum health, at least one health point, every five seconds.
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.fixate: Devouring form: the spread narrows to seven tenths and the reach to eight tenths, but power x1.2, burn duration x1.3 and a longer cooldown — good for burning one target hard.
Wildfire form: spreads farther and wider to catch a whole row at once, but power x0.85 and a shorter burn.
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.growth: From level %1$s the flame power rises to %2$s.
From level %1$s it rises again to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.burningjealousy.prefer: On (Devouring): the spread narrows to seven tenths and the reach to eight tenths, but power x1.2, burn duration x1.3 and a longer cooldown — good for burning one freshly raised target hard. Off (Wildfire): spreads farther and wider to catch a whole row at once, but power x0.85 and a shorter burn.
The partner only considers the jealous flame while a threat is this close; larger lets it open the burn from farther out.
Once a target's positive stages add up to this much, the flame rises above ordinary combat priority; set 1 to pounce on any hint of a boost, higher to wait until it has piled up.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to spit a fan of jealous flame.
